description: DELMIA is Dassault Systèmes' portfolio for manufacturing, supply chain and service operations, covering manufacturing simulation and virtual twins of plants and processes, industrial engineering, workforce and logistics management, supply chain planning and optimisation, and industrial AI and augmented reality. Its named applications include DELMIA Apriso for manufacturing operations, DELMIA Ortems and DELMIA Quintiq for planning and scheduling, and DELMIA 3DLean. It is produced by Dassault Systèmes and runs on the 3DEXPERIENCE platform, which the company describes as cloud-based and collaborative across sites and companies. Coverage is global, aimed at manufacturers and supply chain providers of all sizes, with examples from automotive and electric vehicle production. Licences are commercial, sold as bundles such as Manufacturing Engineering and PLM Express, and prices are not published, so cost is paid. Caveat: the product page is marketing material and does not document model formats or validation. For simulation it builds virtual twins of factories and supply chains to test layouts, schedules and disruption responses through discrete-event and optimisation runs. It is related to the AVEVA PI System and ISA-95 records in this catalogue, which cover plant data and operations integration.
